questions.prompt: A student prepares a solution of the soluble salt lithium sulfate, using the neutralisation reaction between sulfuric acid and the alkali lithium hydroxide. To make sure that she obtains a pure solution of the salt, she first carries out a titration to find the volumes of sulfuric acid and lithium hydroxide that react exactly together. She uses this method in the titration. use a pipette to add 25.0 cm3 of dilute sulfuric acid to a conical flask add a few drops of phenolphthalein indicator fill a burette with lithium hydroxide solution add the lithium hydroxide solution from the burette until the indicator just changes colour
